legal.title: Legal notice
legal.body: Kitho is a family organizing tool. It does not replace professional financial advice. Finances and budgets are coming in a future release.
legal.privacyBody: We use your Google account to sign you in. We store your display name, your photo if you choose one, and your family data. At this stage there is no analytics with personal data.
legal.termsBody: Kitho helps you organize your family. It does not replace financial or legal advice. By using it you agree to treat your group with respect.
